name: com.stickerbyvin/window-sticker
title: StickerByVIN
description: Original car window sticker (Monroney label) by VIN: free check, full sticker with an API key.

tools.name: check_window_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user has a 17-character VIN and wants the window sticker (Monroney label), build sheet, factory options list, packages, original MSRP, trim, engine, recalls or paint code for that vehicle, for example to check a used car or a listing's claims. Works for any make sold new in the US. The check is free and needs no account or key. For the VIN it returns: the decoded year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, transmission, body, fuel and assembly plant; whether the original factory window sticker is on file; when no original is on file, whether a window sticker rebuilt from the VIN's factory build data (not the original printed label) can be made; how many recalls were issued for the model, with NHTSA's open-recall check for the VIN; where the paint code label is on that make; and a link to the StickerByVIN page for the VIN. Original stickers are on file mainly for Ford, Lincoln, Chevrolet, GMC, Buick, Cadillac, Jeep, Ram, Dodge, Chrysler, Fiat, Alfa Romeo, Hyundai, Genesis, Kia, Toyota, Lexus, Mitsubishi, Nissan and Infiniti (a factory sticker copy from the dealer system) and 2021 and later Subaru; coverage varies by model year. For other makes, such as Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Audi, Honda, Acura, Mazda, Porsche, Volvo and Tesla, and for VINs with no original on file, the rebuilt sticker is offered for model year 1981 and later (for older vehicles it can be built only when factory build data exists for that car). The sticker (original or rebuilt) lists the factory options and packages with their prices and the MSRP; this tool says whether one exists but does not list the options or prices itself. It does not return accident, title, ownership or mileage history or a market value.

vin.description: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number, as printed on the dashboard, door jamb, title or listing. Letters I, O and Q never appear in a VIN.

tools.name: get_original_sticker
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the contents of the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) for a 17-character VIN, such as the options list, packages or MSRP when new: total MSRP, base price, destination charge, every factory option and package with its price, exterior and interior color, engine, transmission, fuel economy, standard equipment, the factory paint code and a link to the original sticker PDF (valid 1 hour). Needs a StickerByVIN API key on a Starter plan or above, sent as "Authorization: Bearer sbv_live_..." or as ?api_key= on the MCP URL. Each call counts as one API call against the key’s monthly quota. Returns an error (sticker_not_available) when the API cannot supply an original sticker for the VIN; it never returns a rebuilt sticker. check_window_sticker says for free whether an original is on file.
